# Prince Achar

> Heritage pickle (achar), murabba, chutney and fruit-candy maker from Khari Baoli,
> Old Delhi, India. Operating since 1980, run by Panna Lal Tavinder Kumar.
> Products are handcrafted in small batches using traditional Delhi recipes,
> sun-matured with pure mustard oil and carefully selected spices.

All products are vegetarian. Preservative-free. Made in India.

## Key facts

- Store: Shop No. 6673, Khari Baoli Road, Fatehpuri, Chandni Chowk, Delhi 110006, India
- Phone: +91 98110 56593
- Email: pannalaltavinderkumar@gmail.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/princeacharindia/
- Established: 1980
- Shipping: across India; free on orders above ₹500, flat ₹50 below that
- Shelf life: 12 months unopened; once opened, use within 3 months in a cool, dry place
- Website: https://princeachar.com

## Product range

- Pickles (achar): mango, lime, karonda, mixed, garlic, green chilli, ginger,
  kamal kakri (lotus stem), amla and more
- Murabba: amla (with and without silver leaves), apple, bail, bans (bamboo)
- Chutneys: sweet and savory condiments
- Fruit candies: amla candy and similar
- Plum-cake ingredients (for the Christmas season)

Typical pack sizes: 250g, 500g, 1kg. Prices in INR, roughly ₹260–₹520 per jar.

## History

First-prize winner at Delhi fairs for pickles and murabbas across four decades,
recognised by Lt. Governors, Chief Ministers and the Vice President's office
(1983, 1985, 1986, 1987, 1988, 1995, 2003–2012). Featured by Hindustan Times
for its legacy of authentic flavors.
